widgets_values: An elderly street calligrapher sitting at a small foldable wooden table under a large tree in a quiet city park. Ultra photorealistic details: deep facial wrinkles, soft morning light reflecting on his slightly oily skin, visible pores, and fine white beard hairs. Wearing a faded olive-green jacket with frayed cuffs and a thin knitted scarf. His hands—weathered, veined, slightly trembling—hold a traditional brush dipped in dark ink. Paper sheets with fresh strokes lie on the table, edges curling slightly from humidity. A metal thermos with scratches stands beside him. Background: blurred park path, distant joggers, pigeons pecking near his feet. Shallow depth of field, cinematic color grading, soft natural rim light filtering through tree leaves, ultra-detailed textures, real-world imperfections. Shot on a 50mm lens, handheld documentary style.

A beautiful young European woman standing beside a sunlit stone balcony overlooking an old European street at golden hour, gently adjusting her loose wavy hair as warm light grazes her shoulders. Ultra photorealistic details: natural fair skin with visible pores, soft golden highlights along her collarbone, subtle pink tones on her cheeks, fine micro-hairs glowing in the sunlight. She wears an off-shoulder linen blouse with delicate fabric texture, natural folds, and a slightly relaxed drape that gives a refined, sensual elegance without being revealing. Her blue-green eyes reflect the sunset with cinematic clarity, and her lips have a soft natural sheen. One hand rests lightly on the stone railing, showing graceful fingers, clean nails, and subtle vein texture. Background softly blurred: historic buildings with warm facades, hanging flower pots, drifting dust particles in the glowing light. Cinematic European atmosphere, shallow depth of field, warm golden-hour realism captured with an 85mm portrait lens.
